name: El Morado glacier
region: El Morado Natural Monument, Cajón del Maipo
why: The Andes in a day from Santiago: a mountain lagoon at 2,400 m under Cerro El Morado, then the foot of a glacier.
book: CONAF entry ticket online (Pases Parques). 93 km and 2.5 h from Santiago by the G-25; in season Metrobús 72 leaves Bellavista de La Florida from 7:30.
water: Streams; nothing to buy after Baños Morales.
dangers: Altitude 1,900-2,500 m: go slowly the first hour.
turnaround: Rangers ask you to start back from the glacier by 15:00.

points.name: Baños Morales
points.note: The CONAF ranger post at the top of Baños Morales, 1,880 m.

points.name: Laguna El Morado
points.note: About 2.5 h: the lagoon with Cerro El Morado and its hanging glacier behind.

points.name: San Francisco glacier foot, El Morado
points.note: About 2,500 m, the grey moraine under the San Francisco glacier. Don't walk on the ice.
